name: ABC Python SHA-256 research binding
provider: ABC portable Rust SHA-256 through PyO3 0.23.5
encoding_contract: Single-byte-item buffers are accepted. SHA-256 returns immutable 32-byte digests.
error_contract: TypeError for invalid buffers, ValueError for lifecycle errors, and OverflowError for input overflow.
ownership_contract: Each streaming object owns one Rust context, serializes access, and releases it on close or collection.
